scenicChapters.title: Saudi AlUla Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 13 km this is Saudi AlUla Scenic Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

story: 56 km round from Al-`Ula - plan on about 54 min of riding. On the way it passes Elephant Rock, Hegra and Harrat Uwayrid. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.

story: A one-way ride of 110 km, Mecca to Ta’if - roughly 1 h 29 in the saddle. The stops in between: Al Hada hairpins and Al Hada. The highest point is about 1,750 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
